from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FeeItem(BaseModel):
    """A single court fee payment record found in the document."""
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Name of the party bearing the fee")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="Fee amount as written (e.g., '100 元', '减半收取 40 元')")
    fee_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of fee (e.g., '二审案件受理费', '公告费', '一审案件受理费')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt anchoring the fee detail")

class JudgmentFacts(BaseModel):
    """Facts extracted from a single judgment document."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The document identifier (e.g., '判决文书 1')")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Nature of the case (e.g., '业主撤销权纠纷', '财产损害赔偿')")
    appellants: list[str] | None = Field(description="List of appellant names")
    appellees: list[str] | None = Field(description="List of appellee names")
    ruling_summary: str | None = Field(description="Main ruling decision (e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判', '撤销一审判决')")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court (e.g., '浙江省龙港市人民法院')")
    fee_details: list[FeeItem] = Field(default_factory=list, description="List of court fee payment records")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentFacts]
